Chapter 191: The One True God: God General Lu!

Tudou.com's office was still the same three-bedroom residential apartment.

The company's team had grown from five to eight people.

Two of the new additions were programmers, specifically hired to optimize and improve the video buffering function.

Thanks to its partnership with Xiaonei.com, Tudou.com's user base was growing rapidly.

Before National Day, the number of registered users finally broke 150,000, with about 270,000 daily video plays and over 600 new videos uploaded each day.

This was already very impressive; 56.com only had a quarter of its traffic.

Currently, the UCG video websites consisted of only Tudou.com and 56.com, which mainly relied on user-generated content.

Sites like LeTV and Sohu, on the other hand, did not allow users to upload videos and relied purely on officially released content.

6.cn, Ku6, and others had not yet launched.

"Wow, this video has so many views!"

Hearing the employee's cry of surprise, Wang Wei hurried over to check.

The video's title read: "Zhen Ji vs. Lu Xun, Who is the True King of Duels?"

Wang Wei stared at the video for a long time but couldn't understand what it meant.

He didn't play "Sanguosha" and had no idea about the rules.

A programmer from the company explained, "This is a video of a 1v1 qualifying match from the Sanguosha National Collegiate League. Originally, the King of Duels is Sun Quan, but he, Cao Cao, Hua Tuo, Lü Meng, and the God Generals are all banned in the competition. With these bans, Zhen Ji is widely recognized as the king of duels in tournaments."

"But there's more than one Sanguosha video. Why does this one have such an ridiculously high view count?" Wang Wei asked.

The programmer said, "In the video, Zhen Ji, the King of Duels, had two explosive turns throughout the entire game. But Lu Xun managed to endure them all with his Chain Connection skill. In the end, Lu Xun made a comeback kill at low health. Even with Zhen Ji having the Bagua armor, Lu Xun chained 23 cards in one go."

Another female employee added, "From the start of the Sanguosha League qualifiers until now, in less than four days, our registered users have increased by more than thirty thousand! That's equivalent to about a month's growth after we started collaborating with Xiaonei.com. And our daily video plays have surged to 500,000, basically doubling our previous numbers!"

Wang Wei thought for a moment and then instructed, "Go to more game forums and Tieba to promote this. Encourage players of all kinds of games to create gaming videos and upload them to Tudou.com."

The view count for the Zhen Ji and Lu Xun duel video was still climbing.

Some people couldn't even be bothered to register for a Tudou.com account but rushed over after hearing about it from elsewhere, watching the video over and over again.

It was just too godly, as if someone was cheating.

And it was as if both players were cheating. Zhen Ji had two consecutive explosive bursts, drawing a total of 19 cards. Yet, she still failed to finish off Lu Xun and was even counter-killed by him at low health.

At this moment, the Sanguosha game client featured a link to this video on Tudou.com, while the official Sanguosha website had embedded the Tudou.com video for direct viewing.

A large number of players weren't even playing the game anymore, just watching the video and chatting.

"My God Lu is just awesome. What is Zhen Ji?"

"The one true god of Sanguosha—God General Lu!"

"Seriously, watching Lu Xun's Chain Connection made my scalp tingle."

"This is definitely the best match since the tournament began."

"Hahaha, that player used up a whole year's worth of luck. He lost the next two matches in a row, couldn't draw any cards he needed."

"Cards aren't everything, but you can't do anything without them."

"Out with the old, in with the new."

"I'm still too young and naive."

"By the way, that Tudou.com is pretty interesting. You can actually upload your own videos."

"You're just finding that out?"

Youke had also sent Sanguosha's match recordings to 56.com, though half a day later than Tudou.com. Moreover, the official Sanguosha site did not link to 56.com.

But it had still managed to boost 56.com's popularity a little.

The tournament qualifiers lasted a full seven days, with the "Top Ten Duels of the Day" selected each day and made into videos for players to enjoy. The rest of the matches were all covered through text and image broadcasts.

At the end of last year, the number of broadband users in China was 25.8 million. More users were still on dial-up.

By National Day of this year, the number of broadband users had increased to 35 million.

Broadband users were increasing by an average of 1.02 million per month!

It was precisely this high-speed growth that provided the foundation for the development of Xiaonei.com, Kaixin.com, and Sanguosha, as well as the environment for the development of Tudou.com and 56.com.

"The upcoming North and South Regional round-robin tournaments will be held online every weekend," Qu Guohao said, "and will continue until the end of the semester. The round of sixteen, semifinals, and finals will be held offline during the winter break. At that time, we'll also sell tickets for the live event and invite Game FY to record and broadcast it."

Chen Guiliang asked, "How effective have the activities been these past few days?"

Qu Guohao said, "Our daily active users have doubled, and daily top-ups have nearly doubled. University student players are especially enthusiastic because they each have their own school teams. Some schools have already been eliminated, but their students are still supporting other schools from the same city."

"After watching the match recordings and picture-and-text posts, players can't help but log in to the game for a few rounds. They get hyped up and top up their accounts. Diaochan's 'National Beauty' skin is selling the best, followed by Lu Xun's 'Burning the Linked Camps' skin."

"On 17173's game-specific section, 'World of Warcraft' is ranked first, 'Fantasy Westward Journey' second, 'Audition Online' third, and our 'Sanguosha' is fourth. Someone even drew a risqué comic of Lu Xun making Zhen Ji cry."

"During the offline competition, I plan to put out a call for player cosplayers, with every general getting a cosplay. This can be used for pre-match warm-ups, media promotion, and it also enhances player engagement."

Chen Guiliang nodded in approval. "You've got a knack for organizing events."

After a few more words, Chen Guiliang returned to his office.

As he passed Xu Fengyin's desk, Chen Guiliang praised her, "The 'National Beauty' Diaochan skin you drew is fantastic. It's already set a new single-item sales record for Sanguosha. Keep up the good work!"

"Is there a bonus?" Xu Fengyin asked expectantly.

Chen Guiliang said, "It's calculated as part of your performance review and will be given out with the year-end bonus."

"Yay!"

Xu Fengyin pumped her fist.

The comic girl who had suffered a social death was finally emerging from the shadow of being "doxxed."

She found that although her colleagues occasionally teased her, they didn't say anything overly offensive. The fans who had flocked to follow her on Kaixin.com were all begging her for new fan works, and it seemed no one looked down on risqué fan art.

Just as Xu Fengyin was celebrating her future bonus, an employee who followed industry news cursed angrily, "Damn it, Tencent launched 'Yingxiongsha,' and it's starting its open beta this Saturday. QQ users can log in directly to 'Yingxiongsha,' and after completing in-game missions, they can even display a 'Sha' character on their QQ user panel!"

Several Youke employees gathered around.

"Isn't this just a carbon copy of 'Sanguosha'?"

"Although we adopted the basic rules of 'BANG!', we've made many innovations. Based on this 'Yingxiongsha' description, it's just a blatant copy of 'Sanguosha'!"

"Can we sue them for plagiarism?"

"I'm afraid we can't. The graphics and text are different, so it doesn't count as plagiarism."

"Fuck. First, they copied 'Happy Farm' to make 'QQ Farm,' and now they're copying 'Sanguosha' to make 'Yingxiongsha.' Why are they only copying us?"

"It's not just us. Tencent has also copied Lianzhong's game lobby and casual games. Our current Youke Interactive is actually imitating Lianzhong and QQ Games. And Shanda's 'Crazy Arcade' was also copied by Tencent into 'QQ Tang'."

Chen Guiliang walked over, looked at Tencent's promotional announcement, and simply said, "It's fine. It won't affect us."

"Yingxiongsha" copied "Sanguosha" so excessively that it didn't even change the hero skills, only slightly modifying the skill descriptions to evade plagiarism issues.

This kind of behavior would infuriate "Sanguosha" players.
